visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of two red and white arcade machines themed after Pokémon Poke Balls. A young woman with black hair and a denim jacket stands in the center, gesturing to the machines. The background features a brightly lit store environment with yellow accents and a large Pokémon Mezastar banner overhead. (2) The camera cuts to the woman standing before a massive white wall display containing dozens of colorful small plastic tags (Mezastar tags) arranged in a grid. She smiles broadly, looking at the camera while her hands are open towards the collection. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (3) A close-up shows the woman's hand inserting a coin into a silver slot on the machine. Shortly after, she retrieves a small rectangular tag from a dispensing tray. She holds it up to the camera; it's a gold-bordered tag featuring a Pokémon character. (4) The woman is now seated at the arcade machine next to a man wearing glasses and a floral shirt. They are both looking at the screen which shows high-intensity gameplay. The woman holds up a 'Mega Venusaur' tag with a joyful expression, pointing to it with her other hand. (5) On the arcade screen, digital animations of Pokémon battles are visible, specifically showing a Snorlax being caught in a digital Poke Ball. The woman is seen from the side, focused on the controls, which consist of large blue and red buttons and a central dial. (6) The woman uses her smartphone to scan a QR code on the machine's interface. A close-up reveals a 'Multi-functional Scanner' label on the hardware, which emits a blue light as she places her phone screen over it. The background shows social media instructions on a small screen. (7) The woman stands in front of a giant Poké Ball sculpture and a large purple Gengar display. She mimics the Gengar's claws with her hands, smiling playfully. The store design includes purple walls and circular neon lights that mirror Pokémon motifs. (8) A fast-paced montage shows the woman and her companion rapidly tapping the large buttons on the control panel. Their hands move in a blur of motion. Close-up shots show three tags being placed into designated slots on the machine's surface to activate characters in the game. (9) The woman and the man stand together in front of the arcade machines, each holding up multiple Mezastar tags towards the lens. They are waving and smiling, concluding the tour of the specialized store.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 寶可夢明耀之星特色店. [Slogan]: Pokémon MEZASTAR. [Logo]: MEZASTAR Station TAIPEI. (2) [Slogan]: 全台灣有超過900個地點. (3) [Subtitle]: 一進到店裡就先看到夢幻卡匣牆. (4) [Subtitle]: 遊戲開始的時候呢 先投入30元. (5) [Subtitle]: 就可以隨機獲得一張寶可夢明耀之星卡匣. (6) [Subtitle]: 我最後一場和Nash玩聯手活動對戰的時候. (7) [Subtitle]: 還抽到了超級明星MEZASTAR卡匣的妙蛙花耶. (8) [Subtitle]: 除了剛開始的隨機卡匣外. (9) [Subtitle]: 使用卡匣跟寶可夢對戰. (10) [Subtitle]: 對戰結束的時候 就可以藉由再投30元 捕獲其他的寶可夢. (11) [Subtitle]: 我還有很幸運的捕獲到卡比獸喔 Nash超級羨慕的. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且千萬不要忘記喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 加入SEGA Taiwan官方LINE. (14) [Subtitle]: 就可以免費註冊訓練家ID 可以讓你的遊玩體驗更有趣喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 店內的空間非常舒適. (16) [Subtitle]: 中間的卡匣區還可以看到各種卡匣們 完全充滿歡樂的氛圍. (17) [Subtitle]: 遊戲玩法簡單易懂. (18) [Subtitle]: 只需要連打按鈕 就可以體驗到有趣的對戰. (19) [Subtitle]: 卡匣可以拿來遊玩或者收藏 上陣的感覺很帥氣. (20) [Subtitle]: 無論是新手還是資深玩家 相信都可以輕鬆上手. (21) [Subtitle]: 有空快來體驗看看吧!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy female narration and upbeat, synth-heavy background music reminiscent of video game soundtracks. The voice is clear, bright, and projects excitement. There is a faint indoor room tone indicating a public space but it is well-controlled. (2) A sharp metallic clink and a mechanical sliding sound trigger as a coin is inserted into the machine. The music continues at a steady 128 BPM tempo with a strong 4/4 beat. The narrator's pitch rises when mentioning the location name. (3) Digital UI sound effects, including high-pitched 'dings' and 'pops', punctuate the narrator's description of getting a tag. A male voice (Nash) offers a brief exclamation of surprise. The mix is dominated by the crisp vocal and the driving rhythm of the BGM. (4) During the gameplay description, the audio becomes dense with 'impact' sound effects from the arcade game—explosive bursts and electronic shimmers. The narrator's speech rate increases to match the visual action. (5) A distinct electronic 'beep' signals the successful registration via the scanner. The BGM maintains its high spectral brightness and percussive energy. (6) Rapid, low-frequency percussive thuds are heard as the players hit the arcade buttons. These transients are layered over the continuous BGM and the narrator's enthusiastic summary. (7) The video ends with a warm closing statement from the narrator. The background music swells slightly for the final beat before a quick fade-out, with the speech and music maintaining a balanced ratio throughout.
